title: Agent frontmatter contract — crypto-bot
description: Every .claude/agents/*.md file carries this YAML frontmatter as its canonical contract. The body is the prompt; if they conflict, fix the body. Lint with scripts/validate_agent_frontmatter.py (needs PyYAML; jsonschema optional via --schema). Ported 2026-09-02 from siamese-reconcile and re-fitted to crypto-bot's ACTUAL contract: all 21 agents carry name/description/model/tools/permissionMode/maxTurns/memory, and none carries siamese's agent_id/version/model_rationale — requiring those would have failed 21 files for fields this repo has never used, which is a schema bug, not 21 agent bugs. The model enum also admits 'inherit', which adversarial-reviewer, citation-verifier and deep-researcher use deliberately: their substantive work runs on Gemini 2.5 Pro via a direct OpenRouter call, so the wrapper's own model is the parent session's. The load-bearing crypto-bot check lives in the validator, not here: every hook command in the frontmatter must POINT AT A FILE THAT EXISTS. The 2026-09-02 port renamed seven hooks, and a frontmatter naming a moved hook fails SILENTLY at runtime — Claude Code cannot run it, and a non-2 exit is treated as non-blocking, which is the exact fail-open shape the port exists to remove.

model.description: 'inherit' = the wrapper runs on the parent session's model because the substantive work is delegated cross-model via OpenRouter (architecture.md C.2).
